主要内容: Estée Lauder Companies Inc. disclosed restructuring initiatives under its Leading Beauty Forward program, expecting charges between $600 million and $700 million (before tax) through fiscal 2021. From January 1, 2017, to February 16, 2017, the company approved initiatives to optimize corporate functions, reduce workforce, and improve productivity through position eliminations and re-leveling. It also approved consulting and professional services for future structures and technologies, as well as training and recruitment costs for new capabilities. Cumulative charges through February 16, 2017, totaled $322 million, with $153 million allocated to restructuring. The company expects to record approximately $72 million in restructuring and other charges before tax. These efforts aim to enhance operational efficiency and market competitiveness as part of its long-term strategic plan.
